global_instructions: Codex-specific guidance: select the configured role when delegation is useful and request its configured model and permissions through supported runtime controls. If spawn_agent supports fork_turns and full-history forks inherit the parent model, use fork_turns="none" with a bounded task brief and explicitly set model to the configured role model; choose reasoning effort for that task. Verify the actual child model from runtime metadata when available. A role TOML sandbox_mode is not proof of enforced isolation; inspect effective runtime permissions and disclose any limitation. Choose reasoning effort for each task based on complexity and risk using supported runtime controls; do not pin it in role configuration. Use implementer_deep for difficult implementation. On model-selection or usage-limit failure, follow the model fallback policy while preserving the role and sandbox mode. If the runtime cannot override the model or effort, report that limitation; do not pretend prompt text changes runtime settings. When role-type selection is unavailable, preserve the intended role, permissions, scope, completion condition, and evidence in the available delegation mechanism.
agent_instructions: Use the configured sandbox mode and report evidence for every conclusion or change.
